XDOCUMENTO.Titolo: ABS, ESP, service and tire pressure light on.
XDOCUMENTO.InfoDoc: AIRBAG | CONTROL UNIT | B0100 | B0101 | U0422 | U1726 | RED | SPORADICALLY | OCCASIONALLY | TRIANGLE | DANGER | GENERAL | YELLOW | FLASHING | FLASH |

XCAPITOLO.Corpo:
Reliability level key

* low level : Reported by a garage mechanic; fault case not recorded by the manufacturer.

** medium level : Widespread occurrence of the fault, confirmed by service technicians and independent repairers.

*** high level : Confirmed fault, with a high degree of ‘recurrence’ reported by the manufacturer.

• System: Airbag

  • Device: Airbag control unit

  • Fault: The airbag warning light (red) is constantly on. The passenger-side airbag deactivation light (yellow) and the general fault warning light come on sporadically. Furthermore, in some cases, the total mileage flashes.

  • Errors detected by the self-diagnostic system:
    • B0100 (Airbag control unit – Fault)
    • B0101 (Airbag control unit power supply – Fault)
    • U0422 (Active Suspension Control Unit – Invalid data received)
    • U1726 (No communication with Airbag Control Unit)
  • Cause: Faulty Airbag Control Unit

• Action: Check the condition and correct operation of the airbag control unit; if necessary, repair or replace it

  • Procedure: - -

  • Note: Following the replacement, it was necessary to programme the new control unit, thereby resolving the problem once and for all.
    The component is located in the passenger compartment, on the centre console, and is accessible from beneath the passenger-side storage compartment, after removing a plastic cover.
